title: Reduced DNF for three-bit sorting
statement: Consider the DNF formula on three sign-valued coordinates whose terms require, respectively, that coordinates $0$ and $1$ both have sign $-1$, that coordinates $1$ and $2$ both have sign $1$, or that coordinate $0$ has sign $1$ and coordinate $2$ has sign $-1$. Each term is the conjunction of its two indicated literals, and the formula is the disjunction of these three terms.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the helper constructor DNFTerm.pair; the stated literal interpretation follows from the Literal and DNFTerm field descriptions.
